The company posted adjusted earnings of $0.15 per share, handily beating the consensus forecast of $0.11. content.title: B&G Foods (NYSE:BGS) Posts Q3 Sales In Line With Estimates
content.summary: Packaged foods company B&G Foods (NYSE:BGS) met Wall Streets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, but sales fell by 4.7% year on year to $439.3 million. The company’s outlook for the full year was close to analysts’ estimates with revenue guided to $1.83 billion at the midpoint. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.15 per share was 35.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
